title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 state machines, lifecycles, economies, containment + whole-corpus operations screen (attempt 1)
description: Second sequential child of eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (read it incl. all notes, bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent, the subsystem review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7 groups S4/S5/S6 and S1.16-S1.18 in full with parts 4 and 6 identifier corrections, and child 1's notes eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.1). Reuse child 1's infrastructure: magicItemFaithfulOperations.ts table (typed requirement/trigger/target must be a verbatim description span or the import throws; dropped costs need adjudicated-by-design clauses with verbatim spans; activation.cost optional). SCOPE: (A) S4 state graphs/timers/terminations (S4.01-S4.12), (B) S5 entityGrant lifecycle/control/revertOn (S5.01-S5.06; e.g. elemental vessels and Elemental Gem must not revert on concentration-ended - conjure elemental: concentration broken -> elemental does not disappear, becomes hostile, lasts the remaining hour), (C) S6 economies/composition (S6.02 Luck Blade wish once per dawn; S6.03 Rod of Alertness activate-aura vs activate-protective-aura -> one identity owning action + daily use; S6.04-S6.06), (D) containment S1.16-S1.18, (E) WHOLE-CORPUS OPERATIONS: extend the lexical cost/command-word screen and the verbatim requirement/trigger/target check from child 1's table to EVERY magic-item operation (child 1 found 31 operations typed 'free' and 12 typed 'action' with no printed action - e.g. Ring of Elemental Command casts (also lack plane/help-slay prerequisite), Javelin of Lightning, Marvelous Pigments, Staff of Power - and paraphrased requirement/target strings such as Gem of Brightness blinding-beam, Ring of Shooting Stars cast-faerie-fire): make each exact (verbatim) or absent (adjudicated with span); the screen must then cover the whole corpus, not a table subset. (F) Cloak of the Bat end-polymorph adjudicated span currently cites the casting sentence - cite the printed passage that governs ending (or the inherited polymorph spell rule) truthfully. RULE: faithful or absent; never invent defaults; absent = adjudicated-by-design with verbatim span. RUNTIME SAFETY: re-run child 1's readiness comparison (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over all item/variant/operation combinations before/after) and keep the passing set identical unless a change is source-required and reported; check every runtime consumer of stateMachine/economies/entityGrant/containment (itemState, itemResetExecutor, usageCounters, itemRandomInitialization, toolUseItem, toolSpendUsage, toolResetUsage, magicItemVariants, discovery) before changing fields. Evidence: generalized checks extended to these blocks + representative eligible/ineligible scenarios per root cause (not per-item reproducers); regenerate pack + inventory; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack; update the registry/inventory text that describes these blocks truthfully. Importer protocol; never edit records.json directly. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: member table + readiness comparison; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes:
COMPLETION (commit 01368315 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.2, not pushed; verify:worktree green 356 files / 6650 tests; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack green). Mechanisms: magicItemFaithfulSpecKit.ts (shared patch/clause vocabulary), magicItemFaithfulOperationsCorpus.ts (85 whole-corpus table entries, 125 operation patches, 44 unprinted costs dropped, merged by key into child 1's table), magicItemFaithfulLifecycles.ts (26 reviewed items; every free-text claim built only via ctx.span/ctx.between, i.e. a VERBATIM description span or the compile throws; withholdBlock turns a typed block's readiness clause into adjudicated-by-design with a verbatim span). Pack diff: magic-item records only; readiness adjudicated-by-design 55 -> 107, engine-pending 792 -> 791 (Cloak of Displacement state machine withheld), green 212 unchanged. Registry census unchanged (adjudicated clauses carry the owner family tag). Pinned tests updated for source-required changes only: srdGeneratedPack clause counts (1060->1111), legacy backlog (793->792, hash; Cloak of Displacement M5 hook candidate left), Orb requirement now 'If you control the orb'. Inventory regenerated (1926 rows).

(E) WHOLE-CORPUS SCREEN: magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts now screens all 367 operations of all 240 items and variants (independent census count asserted): action/bonus/reaction/free costs and commandWord only where printed; every requirement/trigger/target is a WHOLE-WORD verbatim description span (catches 'self' inside 'yourself'); result 0 violations (was 31 'free' + 12 'action' unprinted + ~100 paraphrased fields). Counterfactual cases keep the screen able to fail. Fixed unprinted/paraphrased: Ring of Elemental Command (17 casts: cost removed, slay prerequisite 'If you help slay a/an <plane> elemental while attuned to the ring' verbatim; 4 dominate ops: plane heading + target; unlock op: 4 per-plane clauses), Javelin of Lightning, Marvelous Pigments, Dwarven Thrower, Staff of Power/Striking/Withering, Holy Avenger, Arrow of Slaying, Cube of Force contact loss, Ioun Reserve/Absorption, Luck Blade, Oathbow (command PHRASE not command word), Spell Storing/Turning, Rod of Absorption, Staff of Charming, Sphere of Annihilation, Sword of Wounding, Dimensional Shackles escape, Gem of Brightness beam/cone, Ring of Shooting Stars faerie fire (wearing sentence governs only the two at-will spells), Armor of Invulnerability (verbatim-but-wrong-context 'wearing the armor' removed), 17 potion/philter 'self' targets removed, oils, dusts, wands/rods/robes holding/wearing spans, Wand of Binding assisted-escape trigger, Dwarven Plate, Scarab, Gloves of Missile Snaring, Ring of Evasion. (F) Cloak of the Bat end-polymorph clause note now states the cloak prints no ending of its own, the inherited polymorph spell rule governs (duration / 0 hit points), and the cited sentence is the only printed passage that casts it.

MEMBER TABLE. S4 (state graphs; exact = graph states printed events, withheld = adjudicated verbatim span): S4.01 Apparatus lever 1 never moves hatch (self-loops), lever 10 sealed<->open per table cells EXACT; S4.02 Dagger of Venom 'hits a creature' + termination verbatim EXACT; S4.03 Dancing Sword launch = first attack, 4th returns, grasp/30-ft stop from every hovering state, two fall branches EXACT; S4.04 Decanter stops at start of next turn, invented stop-water op REMOVED; S4.05 Staff of Swarming Insects scope (others than you), centered on you, wind ends it, invented dismissal op + 20-ft cutoff REMOVED; S4.06 Broom landing (not dismount) stops hovering, dismount op + unprinted arrival transition REMOVED, recall -> parked; S4.07 Cloak of Displacement independent suppression lifetimes: state machine + 2 ops WITHHELD (adjudicated, verbatim span); S4.08 Glamoured verified (child 1: active->active set-appearance, remove-armor cutoff); S4.09 Eversmoking Bottle growth gated on open+within, close -> lingering 10-min cloud (timer), wind tiers in termination span EXACT; S4.10 Rope of Climbing action only animates, movement/fasten/knot not chained (clause), ops kept bound as self-loops EXACT; S4.11 Ioun Stone seizure attack-vs-AC-24 OR DC-24 check, grab-orbiting-stone untouched (stays green); S4.12 Instant Fortress destroyed state REMOVED, component HP + wish repair in clause. S5: S5.01 five conjure-elemental vessels (Bowl, Brazier, Censer, Stone, Elemental Gem) revertOn no longer concentration-ended, note states the spell exception (does not disappear, hostile, 1 hour after summoning) EXACT; S5.02 Obsidian Steed reverts only on obeyed command (obeyed-owner-command-while-touching) EXACT; S5.03 Staff of Power + Staff of the Magi retributive-escape outcome is the verbatim printed passage (bystanders save regardless of breaker escape) EXACT; S5.04 Pipes control = verbatim friendly-while-playing + 'starts its turn and can't hear' EXACT; S5.05 Manual of Golems control/note verbatim + eligibility and creation/ashes clauses; S5.06 Goat of Terror already adjudicated (19.4.5.8), verified. S6: S6.01 Nine Lives done in child 1, verified; S6.02 Luck Blade wish costs charge AND new per-day 'wish' economy (reset dawn), luck pool separate EXACT; S6.03 Rod of Alertness one identity activate-protective-aura owns action + daily use + transition (activate-aura removed) EXACT; S6.04 Golden Lions count 1, no dismiss-existing, note verbatim EXACT; S6.05 Orb of Dragonkind exclusiveInstance REMOVED, cooldown clause verbatim; S6.06 Talisman formula already fixed (19.4.5), verified. S1.16 Bag of Devouring overflow = verbatim 'placed wholly' fragments; S1.17 Handy Haversack rupture triggers verbatim ('a sharp object pierces it or tears it'); S1.18 Portable Hole suffocation REMOVED (no closed-state field), clause verbatim. Extra: Feather Token whip payload now attackKind melee-spell-attack + verbatim target (child 1 follow-up 2).

READINESS COMPARISON (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over every item x variant x operation id incl. activate/deactivate, 1048 combos): 19 ready before and after, IDENTICAL (Ammunition hit-target, Boots of Levitation cast-levitate, Candle burn, 14 Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone variants, Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning, Rope of Entanglement escape-rope). First attempt made Rope of Climbing fasten/knot/release newly ready (graph lost their transitions); fixed with state-neutral self-loops so the set stays identical. Pinned in the new test. Consumers (itemState, itemExecutionReadiness, toolSpendUsage/ResetUsage, usageCounters, itemResetExecutor, itemRandomInitialization, discovery) read operation ids, cost, transitions via/from/to/timer/effects, tracksOccupancy; none reads activation/condition/termination/revertOn/control/exclusiveInstance/suffocation; removed operations were never executable.

NOT DONE / follow-ups (within 19.4.6 scope, none duplicated into new beads): (1) the lexical screen proves a cost word appears somewhere in the item text, not that it is printed for THAT operation; operation-level reading was done by hand over all non-table items (documented above) but no generated per-sentence proof exists; (2) producers still DRAFT invented stages (e.g. suppress-displacement, dismiss-insect-cloud, stop-water, dismount-broom) that the reviewed tables remove, the established withholding pattern; (3) stateMachine notes/revertOn strings outside the 9 reviewed graph items are not asserted verbatim; (4) Wand of Secrets/Enemy Detection sense-effect wording not re-reviewed (effects block belongs to 19.4.5).
